methods.label: Factor, prove a lower bound, and attain it
methods.explanation:
The allowed values satisfy \(1\le a,b\le5\). Factor out \(a\) to make the effect of \(b\) easier to see:
\[
2a-ab=a(2-b).
\]
Since \(b\le5\), we have \(2-b\ge-3\). Multiplying by the positive number \(a\) preserves this inequality. Also, \(a\le5\) gives \(-3a\ge-15\). Therefore every allowed pair satisfies
\[
a(2-b)\ge-3a\ge-15.
\]
The allowed choice \(a=b=5\) gives \(2\cdot5-5\cdot5=-15\), so this lower bound is attained. The smallest value is \(\boxed{-15}\), choice \(\text{B}\).
